name: USC-HAD
channel_description: 3 accelerometer (x, y, z) + 3 gyroscope (x, y, z)

protocol.note: Report mean ± std across all 14 LOSO folds.

description: 14 subjects performed 12 activities (Walking Forward, Walking Left, Walking Right, Walking Upstairs, Walking Downstairs, Running Forward, Jumping Up, Sitting, Standing, Sleeping, Elevator Up, Elevator Down) with a hip-mounted MotionNode sensor recording accelerometer and gyroscope data at 100Hz. The task is to segment the stream into 2 second windows with 50% overlap and classify each window into one of the 12 activities. Use Leave-One-Subject-Out cross validation across all 14 subjects. Report mean and standard deviation of the primary metric across the 14 folds.
